title: Community post (3 years ago, approx date)
summary: Poll on opening a Patreon: becoming his family's sole breadwinner means he can't justify 20-25 hours a week on the channel unless viewers fund it; he admits discomfort at taking money.
claims: Making videos took him 20-25 hours a week, which he could not justify once he became his family's sole breadwinner
He let viewers vote on crowdfunding: majority NO meant working more hours and uploading a few times a month; YES meant making content his second job
He dislikes taking viewers' money because the channel's goal was to give back, and fears it puts him close to the grifters he despises
He would rather work for his audience than sink further into the corporate world, which brings him neither joy nor fulfilment
